title: Polynomial layered size for the all-ones language
statement: The language consisting of Boolean words whose entries are all true is recognized by a family of finite-layer Boolean feedforward circuits using only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND gates, with size bounded by a polynomial in the input length.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the all-ones language.
